TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Kai Islands
DATE 10 November 2028 · 1400 local
SIDE Royal Australian Navy
WINDOW 70 min, closes at 105
RQ-7 Shadow. Photo: U.S. Army JMRC by Sgt. Maria Tsukino · Public domain · cropped
"Our stockpiles need to be replenished. And we need this to happen fast."
- Radmila Shekerinska, NATO Deputy Secretary General, 2026

KAI ISLANDS, afternoon. Captain Prasetyo has lent us the strip at Langgur for the enclave relief window and not an hour longer. LANGGUR PROVIDER and KEI STAR carry the fuel bladders and the ground party; you take them the last fifteen miles up the open-water western approach to the offshore transfer anchorage. Local craft take the bladders ashore to Langgur; neither coaster is to enter the passages between the Kai islands.

The enclave knows what Langgur is for. A Meridian escort pair has been working the Kai passages since Tuesday, and the last transit reported a drone launcher site on Kai Besar, across the strait east of the anchorage. Langgur town is beyond the anchorage and every building in it is somebody's.
Get both coasters in. Put the launcher out of the argument if you can do it without touching the town.
COMMAND NET: A mission-specific tactical report follows eight minutes after the start. It is advice from the command team, not a new sensor detection.

FORWARD RECON: MOTH 11, a small RQ-7 reconnaissance UAV, joins over the local approach at minute ten, allowing time for initial air-defence suppression. The field team uses a portable launcher and local recovery lane. Two reserve UAVs are with the team from the start. They are unarmed and have finite fuel. Use their sensors to classify the military installations and update strike aimpoints. The small airframes are vulnerable; no scripted reveal grants a target solution. Keep a recovery margin and reposition the initial track as needed.
Commodore Alex Mercer; Captain Ratna Prasetyo, Indonesian Navy (TNI-AL), for the strip
COMMANDER'S INTENT

Langgur supports the forward aircraft for The Open Door and Second Ring, and a strip is only an alternate if there is fuel on it. Get both coasters into the offshore transfer anchorage west of Kai Kecil. The fuel goes ashore by local craft; do not enter the island passages. Langgur town is beyond the anchorage: nothing in it is yours to break.
• Get both coasters into the western transfer anchorage
• Neutralise the Kai Besar launcher site
• Leave Langgur alone
• Obtain a current classification of the land target area

Your detachment, two fuel coasters. Langgur town at the head of the anchorage, the strip beyond it. Opposing: a Meridian escort pair, a drone launcher site on Kai Besar. Forward RQ-7 field team: two reserve UAVs and a portable launcher; Moth 11 joins at minute ten.

The planned window is 70 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 35 minutes more; the operation is closed at 105 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
